curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Open with the rule that driving on public roads needs a valid license, extend it to sitting at the wheel with the engine running, then cover who can get a regular learner permit, what it allows, and the supervising passenger rule.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; a contrast card separating permit supervision from driving alone on a license.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on what counts as driving and what a permit holder may do.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: List the three permit tests, add the road test for an original license, stress that each test is passed separately, then separate the signs test from the knowledge test.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each test; contrast cards for permit tests versus license tests and signs test versus knowledge test.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps which test belongs to the permit and which to the license.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain when vision is checked, the corrective-lens restriction and its penalty, then how physical or mental conditions and disabilities are judged.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per rule; contrast cards on the lens penalty and on disability versus safe driving ability.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a driver's eyesight or condition and asking what follows.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Place the road test last in the sequence, show when it is and is not required, list what examiners grade and the vehicle you must test in, then walk the three-point turnabout step by step.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for test timing, grading and each turnabout step; a contrast card for the left, right, left wheel pattern.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on road-test timing and the turnabout sequence.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Show that the vehicle decides the class, anchor on the regular Class C most drivers need, then the regular Class A and Class B thresholds and which handbook other applicants study.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per class; contrast cards for regular versus commercial lettering and for the Class A and Class B thresholds.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz describing a vehicle and asking which regular class covers it.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Define who needs a commercial license, the commercial Class A, B and C definitions, the exemptions including volunteer emergency drivers, and the special endorsements.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each commercial class, exemption and endorsement; a contrast card for commercial Class C by what it carries.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described driver needs a commercial license or an endorsement.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the two legal ways to ride a motorcycle, the motorcycle permit conditions by age, then school and activity bus driver requirements and the sex-offender registration bar.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for endorsement versus permit and school versus activity bus drivers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on rider and bus driver eligibility.
